notes: Update coefficient applications and qualify the protected addition lemma; simplify the zero coefficient map with Finsupp.zero_apply. The declaration text replaces MvPolynomial.coeff m p by p.coeff m (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff p applied to m). This is the same coefficient: the original pinned Mathlib defines MvPolynomial.coeff m p as @DFunLike.coe _ _ _ _ (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff p) m (Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Basic.lean:513-514). Expanding that removed wrapper gives the ported expression, with the same polynomial and exponent. No assumptions or conclusions are added or removed.
